info.title: Waste Volume Estimation API
info.description:
## Waste Volume Estimation API

Camera operations are mounted at `/api/v1/cameras`; `/files` serves protected artifacts.

- WebRTC playback uses backend-authenticated WHEP signaling; media flows directly from MediaMTX.
- RTSP calibration capture selects chessboard frames and queues computation. Computed calibrations are inactive until explicitly activated; multipart calibration upload is synchronous and activates its result.
- Snapshots preserve original resolution and record worker-reception UTC time, not sensor time.
- Predictions queue `upload`, `rtsp_frame`, or `latest_rtsp` and persist `pending -> processing -> done/failed`. HTTP 202 acknowledges submission, not completion.
- Grid volume sums cell median heights times cell area. `convex_hull` means 2D footprint-hull area times median height, not a 3D hull. Volume is m³/L, footprint m², height meters; missing estimates remain null. BEV is a visualization, not a complete 3D reconstruction.

### Authentication
Camera operations and artifact downloads require `X-API-Key`. `/`, `/health`, `/docs`, `/redoc`, and `/openapi.json` are public. Keys are configured through `VALID_API_KEYS` or stored hashed in PostgreSQL. Environment-configured keys have wildcard scopes and must not be embedded in browser builds. Missing headers currently return 422; invalid keys return 401 and insufficient scopes return 403.

### Scopes
- `camera:read` / `camera:write` - Camera management
- `calibration:read` / `calibration:write` - Calibration
- `ground_ref:read` / `ground_ref:write` - Ground references
- `predict:read` / `predict:write` - Predictions

### Prediction prerequisites and coordinates
Submission pins an active calibration, a ground model linked to an active reference for that calibration, and an active depth scale for that ground model. There is no public depth-scale setup/readiness endpoint; provisioning is an operator task. New calibrations preserve `k_original`, `k_undist`, and dimensions; `k_matrix` remains the undistorted K. Upload raw images for these calibrations. Legacy uploads without original intrinsics require already-undistorted images; RTSP requires recalibration. Ground-reference image points use undistorted coordinates.

### RTSP sources and output selection
`rtsp_frame` captures at worker execution. `latest_rtsp` requires a fresh persisted snapshot at submission and selects again at execution, without fallback capture. RTSP rejects caller files/timestamps; frame dimensions must exactly match calibration. `return_outputs` is a JSON-array form string: omitted registers all supported outputs, `[]` registers none. Internal files may still be generated; summary/instances/volumes are not filtered. Broker failure returns 503 and marks the job failed; predictions are not automatically redispatched.

### Errors and deployment limits
Errors use `detail` as a string, an object with a safe `code`, or a validation list. Handle all shapes. Browser video/ICE/reconnect, real-camera accuracy, model/GPU inference, TLS/TURN, and dashboard integration still require deployment testing. Legacy ground-reference/model routes do not yet enforce camera-bound API-key restrictions; do not treat them as tenant-isolated.

post.description:
Start accepted-frame capture without waiting for camera frames.

Requires calibration:write and an enabled stream. HTTP 202 persists a queued
session even if broker dispatch fails; the API reconciler retries dispatch.
Poll the returned session_id. completed means the capture target was reached,
not that calibration succeeded. Queue time counts toward the deadline.

Queue computation for a terminal capture with enough selected views.

Requires calibration:write. queued/running/done requests reuse computation;
failed computation can be retried explicitly. Poll compute_status separately

be explicitly activated. Legacy stored frames are quality-assessed first.

post.description:
Queue upload, worker-time RTSP capture, or a freshness-bounded persisted snapshot.

HTTP 202 returns job_id, not a prediction result. Poll GET /predict/{job_id}
until done/failed. Calibration, ground reference/model, and depth scale must
belong to compatible active versions. estimated_duration_sec is a fixed
advisory value, not measured progress or a completion deadline.

source_type.title: Source Type
source_type.description: upload: image file; rtsp_frame: fresh capture at worker execution; latest_rtsp: latest persisted snapshot at execution

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Caller timestamp for upload only; forbidden for RTSP sources

seg_classes.title: Seg Classes
seg_classes.description: JSON array of segmentation class names

max_frame_age_sec.title: Max Frame Age Sec
max_frame_age_sec.description: Maximum RTSP snapshot age in seconds, checked again by the worker

return_outputs.title: Return Outputs
return_outputs.description: JSON array of output types: omitted registers all, [] registers none. Valid types: bev_image, bev_mask_proyeksi, bev_overlay, depth_masked, depth_raw_vis, depth_scaled_vis, height_map, instances_json, lifted_points_npz, mask, overlay, volume_heatmap, volume_result_npz. Internal artifacts may still be generated

file.title: File
file.description: Required for upload, forbidden for RTSP. Raw image at calibration dimensions with explicit intrinsics; legacy calibrations require already-undistorted input

k_matrix.title: K Matrix
k_matrix.description: Undistorted camera intrinsics; legacy field retains this meaning

k_original.title: K Original
k_original.description: Original raw-image intrinsics; null for legacy calibrations, never reconstructed by migration

k_undist.title: K Undist
k_undist.description: Explicit target intrinsics for undistortion, equivalent to k_matrix for new calibrations

per_view_errors.title: Per View Errors
per_view_errors.description: Per-view reprojection RMS errors in pixels

rms_reproj.title: Rms Reproj
rms_reproj.description: Overall reprojection RMS error in pixels

rtsp_url.title: Rtsp Url
rtsp_url.description: Never returned; submit source URLs only on writes.

rtsp_url.title: Rtsp Url
rtsp_url.description: Never returned; submit source URLs only on writes.

target_images.title: Target Images
target_images.description: Accepted chessboard frames for new sessions

max_duration_sec.title: Max Duration Sec
max_duration_sec.description: Wall-clock limit from session creation, including queue time

auto_calibrate.title: Auto Calibrate
auto_calibrate.description: Queue inactive calibration computation after completed/stopped/expired capture; insufficient accepted frames fail computation

corners.title: Corners
corners.description: Detected chessboard corners in original-image pixel coordinates

selection_version.title: Selection Version
selection_version.description: 1 targets accepted frames; legacy 0 targets stored frames, then quality-assesses them at computation

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: Frames accepted by chessboard, sharpness, and pose selection

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: Stored frames rejected by quality selection

compute_status.title: Compute Status
compute_status.description: Independent computation state: none, queued, running, done, failed

result_calibration_id.title: Result Calibration Id
result_calibration_id.description: Inactive calibration UUID after compute succeeds; explicitly activate it via calibrations endpoint

attempted.title: Attempted
attempted.description: Attempts started; interrupted attempts need not equal captured + failed_attempts

captured.title: Captured
captured.description: All stored frames, including rejected ones; maximum 300 per session

source_path.title: Source Path
source_path.description: Private-storage key, not a public URL or filesystem path

source_ts.title: Source Ts
source_ts.description: Upload caller timestamp or RTSP worker-reception UTC time; not sensor time

estimated_duration_sec.title: Estimated Duration Sec
estimated_duration_sec.description: Fixed advisory estimate, not measured progress or an SLA

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Storage key, not a public URL; download through the authenticated job output endpoint

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: UTC worker-reception time, not the camera sensor timestamp

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Configured environment key or active hashed database key. Required scopes depend on the operation. Never put the key in a URL.
